scope: Locally bundled analysis runtime imports and fonts
selectionMethod: Scope is analysis/runtime.js only, not all dependencies of the unified main application.

Start from the ten actual imported external packages (eight JS libraries, two font packages); resolve versions/paths against installed metadata, supplied installed license inventory and pnpm-lock.yaml.

Traverse the pinned production dependencies of D3, markdown-it and JSZip, including resolved transitive dependencies; retain the entire uncertain JSZip production closure despite browser prebundling and substitutions.

Do not traverse devDependencies. Exclude specifically evidenced CLI-only imports argparse, commander, iconv-lite and rw; exclude safer-buffer only reached through excluded iconv-lite. Other top-level app libraries and build tools are out of this entry scope.

Select LICENSE/LICENCE/COPYING/NOTICE/COPYRIGHT/license filenames from the actual installed selected package paths. Include the actual DOMPurify LICENSE + LICENSE-MPL + src/license_header, complete JSZip LICENSE.markdown (both MIT and GPL) + lib/license_header.js, pako LICENSE + lib/zlib/README (MIT AND Zlib), isarray README.md (contains full MIT text), and complete font LICENSE files.

Copy complete selected source files byte-for-byte using cmd copy /b, preceded by separately staged provenance headers. No standard license text is synthesized, fetched or substituted. Entire isarray/pako source README files are retained to preserve all notices and acknowledgments.

Inspect prebundled distributions independently of package dependency metadata: preserve actual Plotly header at lines 1-6 and entire preserved notice/comment appendix at lines 3804-3878. Record Mapbox module version evidence and all identifiable missing embedded component notices.

Add installed object-assign@4.1.1 text only as an explicitly unverified Plotly notice candidate. The full safe-buffer@5.1.2 text is already in the rooted closure; it is not proof of the embedded Plotly version.

This is a conservative installed dependency and locally visible embedded-notice collection, not an exact emitted bundle inventory, source map attribution audit, legal certification or declaration of complete redistribution compliance. No builds, UI checks, installs, downloads or providers were run.
